summary: Make the Toolbar compact, add drag edge scrolling, refine progressive glass, and expand Emoji geometry diagnostics.

changes.title: Scroll Toolbar actions horizontally
changes.detail: The Toolbar now presents its tools in one compact horizontal rail instead of a tall four-column grid. Large gray icon cards are removed, labels stay visible, and drag reorder follows the pointer and scrolls the rail when a drag reaches either edge.

changes.title: Refine progressive panel glass
changes.detail: Toolbar and Clipboard share a smoother translucent top fade that clears progressively over the scrolling content. No host-app screenshot or clipboard copy is created by the panel glass.

changes.title: Reuse Emoji context work on panel open
changes.detail: Emoji opening reads one bounded context snapshot and shares one ranking pass between the Smart row and Recents ordering. The existing local privacy checks and explicit Emoji insertion behavior remain in place; no ContextLM or voice model weights are added.

changes.title: Measure Emoji panel layout without capturing content
changes.detail: The one-shot Emoji geometry trace includes measured and on-screen bounds, parent padding, layout margins, translations, scroll offsets, and system, IME, and gesture insets. It also reports the first drawn Emoji key band and keyboard top padding using geometry only. No typed text, app identity, Emoji values, or screenshots are captured, helping isolate the Reno10 top gap from actual layout evidence.
